sections.title: About Muum Repo Explorer
sections.content: Muum Repo Explorer is an open-source repository discovery and maintenance triage tool for web and macOS. It helps developers find relevant repositories, compare activity signals, and move toward practical maintainer workflows.

sections.title: Product Focus
checklistItems: Search GitHub repositories by topic or custom term.
Sort results by stars, forks, and last update.
Open repository records quickly from a focused table view.
Package the same experience for both web and macOS.

sections.title: Why It Matters
sections.content: Open-source maintainers need faster ways to understand project activity, compare ecosystems, and decide where attention is needed. Muum Repo Explorer starts with discovery and is being shaped into a lightweight maintenance workspace.

sections.title: Codex for Open Source Direction
checklistItems: Summarize repository health from public GitHub signals.
Classify issues and pull requests into actionable maintenance queues.
Draft maintainer handoff notes and release summaries.
Add security and code-quality review support for maintainers.
Use Codex to accelerate web and macOS feature development.

sections.title: Roadmap
checklistItems: Improve GitHub API error, empty, and rate-limit states.
Add repository health and maintainer activity signals.
Add saved research lists and repository comparison.
Add issue and pull request triage views.
Add signed and notarized macOS releases.
Harden dependency security and CI audit coverage.
